ollama_show_qwen_agents.title: Show Qwen Xavi agent models
ollama_show_qwen_agents.description: Show Ollama model metadata for qwen2.5:xavi-agent and qwen2.5-coder:xavi-agent.
argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
for model in ['qwen2.5:xavi-agent','qwen2.5-coder:xavi-agent']:
    payload=json.dumps({'model':model}).encode()
    req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/show',data=payload,headers={'content-type':'application/json'},method='POST')
    print('\n===== '+model+' =====')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:
        d=json.loads(r.read().decode())
    for key in ['license','modelfile','parameters','template','system','details']:
        v=d.get(key)
        if v:
            text=v if isinstance(v,str) else json.dumps(v,indent=2)
            print('--- '+key+' ---')
            print(text[:6000])
PY

inspect_copilot_logs.title: Inspect VS Code Copilot logs
inspect_copilot_logs.description: Read recent VS Code server and Copilot extension logs for errors on production-4.
argv:
set -u
echo '== time =='
date

echo '
== vscode server processes =='
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,stat,%cpu,%mem,etime,cmd --sort=-%cpu | egrep 'code|vscode|extensionHost|copilot|node' | head -n 80 || true

echo '
== installed copilot extensions =='
find "$HOME/.vscode-server/extensions" -maxdepth 1 -type d -iname '*copilot*' -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true

echo '
== recent vscode logs containing copilot/auth/error =='
if [ -d "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/logs" ]; then
  find "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/logs" -type f -mmin -240 2>/dev/null \
    | while read -r f; do
        if grep -IiqE 'copilot|github.copilot|authentication|auth|token|ECONN|ENOTFOUND|ETIMEDOUT|CERT|error|fail|unresponsive|crash|navigator is now a global' "$f"; then
          echo "--- $f ---"
          grep -IinE 'copilot|github.copilot|authentication|auth|token|ECONN|ENOTFOUND|ETIMEDOUT|CERT|error|fail|unresponsive|crash|navigator is now a global' "$f" | tail -n 80
        fi
      done
else
  echo 'no ~/.vscode-server/data/logs'
fi

echo '
== copilot extension log dirs =='
find "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/logs" -type d -iname '*copilot*' -o -type f -iname '*copilot*' 2>/dev/null | tail -n 100 || true

echo '
== extension host logs tail =='
find "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/logs" -type f \( -name 'exthost.log' -o -name '*Extension Host*.log' -o -name 'remoteagent.log' \) -mmin -240 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do echo "--- $f ---"; tail -n 120 "$f"; done

printf '\n== copilot log files ==\n'
find "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/logs" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'copilot|github' | sort | tail -n 100 || true

printf '\n== copilot mentions last 24h ==\n'
find "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/logs" -type f -mmin -1440 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
  if grep -IiqE 'github.copilot|copilot' "$f"; then
    echo "--- $f ---"

sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches fs.inotify.max_user_instances fs.inotify.max_queued_events 2>/dev/null || true

vscode_crash_diagnose.title: Diagnose VS Code remote crash and Copilot state
vscode_crash_diagnose.description: Read recent VS Code remote server logs, installed AI extensions, inotify state, and extension host processes without modifying state.
argv:
set -u
now=$(date '+%F %T %Z')
echo "== time == $now"

echo '
== current vscode/code/node processes =='
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,stat,%cpu,%mem,etime,cmd --sort=-%cpu | egrep 'code|vscode|extensionHost|copilot|node|watcher|ptyHost' | head -n 120 || true

echo '
== listeners related to vscode =='
ss -ltnp | egrep 'code|vscode|34345|8092|8080|11434|18205' || true

echo '
== installed AI/Copilot-ish extensions remote =='
find "$HOME/.vscode-server/extensions" -maxdepth 1 -type d \( -iname 'github.copilot*' -o -iname '*copilot*' -o -iname '*roo*' -o -iname '*cline*' -o -iname '*continue*' -o -iname '*sixth*' -o -iname '*aws*' \) -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true

echo '
== extension package summaries =='
for d in "$HOME"/.vscode-server/extensions/{github.copilot*,rooveterinaryinc.roo-cline*,continue.continue*,sixth.sixth-ai*,amazonwebservices.aws-toolkit-vscode*}; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  echo "--- $(basename "$d") ---"
  python3 - <<PY "$d/package.json"
import json, sys
p=sys.argv[1]
try:
  j=json.load(open(p))
  print('publisher=', j.get('publisher'), 'name=', j.get('name'), 'version=', j.get('version'), 'main=', j.get('main'))
  print('activationEvents=', j.get('activationEvents', [])[:8])
except Exception as e:
  print('error', e)
PY
done

echo '
== latest VS Code server log dirs =='
find "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/logs" -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | head -n 10

echo '
== critical recent log lines last 6h =='
find "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/logs" -type f -mmin -360 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do
  if grep -IiqE 'copilot|github.copilot|Extension Host|ExtensionHost|crash|SIGPIPE|ENOSPC|inotify|ptyHost|heartbeat|unresponsive|ECONN|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|CERT|auth|token|quota|429|401|403|navigator is now a global|aws-toolkit|sixth|roo|cline|continue' "$f"; then
    echo "--- $f ---"
    grep -IinE 'copilot|github.copilot|Extension Host|ExtensionHost|crash|SIGPIPE|ENOSPC|inotify|ptyHost|heartbeat|unresponsive|ECONN|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|CERT|auth|token|quota|429|401|403|navigator is now a global|aws-toolkit|sixth|roo|cline|continue' "$f" | tail -n 120
  fi
done | tail -n 600

echo '
== inotify settings/current counts =='
sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches fs.inotify.max_user_instances fs.inotify.max_queued_events 2>/dev/null || true
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do
  pid=${p#/proc/}
  c=$(find "$p/fd" -lname 'anon_inode:inotify' 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)
  [ "$c" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && printf '%s %s ' "$c" "$pid" && tr '\0' ' ' < "$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null && echo
done | sort -nr | head -n 30

echo '
== workspace watcher excludes =='
for f in /var/www/xavi/.vscode/settings.json "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/Machine/settings.json" "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/User/settings.json"; do
  [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "--- $f ---"; grep -nE 'watcherExclude|search.exclude|files.exclude' "$f" -A60 -B5 || true; }
done

echo '

echo '
== settings files present =='
for f in /var/www/xavi/.vscode/settings.json "$HOME/.vscode-server/data/User/settings.json"; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f"; done

inspect_concretecms_nginx_php.title: Inspect ConcreteCMS nginx/PHP migration state
inspect_concretecms_nginx_php.description: Read old nginx config, current nginx sites, PHP-FPM availability, certbot/certificates, and likely web roots without modifying state.
argv:
set -u
OLD='/media/tbi/bb83b1a5-fef4-4245-8b86-79a952939233/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/xavi.app'
echo '== time =='; date

echo '
== old config path =='
ls -la "$OLD" 2>&1 || true
if [ -r "$OLD" ]; then echo '
== old config contents =='; sed -n '1,240p' "$OLD"; fi

echo '
== current nginx sites =='
ls -la /etc/nginx/sites-available /etc/nginx/sites-enabled 2>&1 || true
for f in /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/* /etc/nginx/sites-available/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "--- $f ---"; sed -n '1,220p' "$f"; }; done

echo '
== nginx version/config test if allowed =='
nginx -v 2>&1 || true
nginx -t 2>&1 || true

echo '
== php installed =='
php -v 2>&1 || true
php-fpm8.3 -v 2>&1 || true
php-fpm8.2 -v 2>&1 || true
php-fpm8.1 -v 2>&1 || true
php-fpm8.0 -v 2>&1 || true

echo '
== php-fpm services =='
systemctl list-unit-files 'php*-fpm.service' --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl list-units 'php*-fpm.service' --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true

echo '
== php fpm sockets =='
ls -la /run/php 2>&1 || true
ss -ltnp | grep -E ':9000|php-fpm' || true

echo '
== common web roots =='
for d in /var/www/xavi /var/www/html /var/www/xavi.app /var/www/concrete /srv/www /media/tbi/bb83b1a5-fef4-4245-8b86-79a952939233/var/www; do echo "--- $d ---"; ls -la "$d" 2>&1 | head -n 80; done

echo '
== certs likely present =='
ls -la /etc/letsencrypt/live 2>&1 || true
find /etc/letsencrypt/live -maxdepth 2 -type l -o -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n '1,120p' || true

echo '
== concrete markers under likely roots =='
for root in /var/www /media/tbi/bb83b1a5-fef4-4245-8b86-79a952939233/var/www; do
  [ -d "$root" ] || continue
  find "$root" -maxdepth 5 \( -name concrete -o -name application -o -name composer.json -o -name index.php \) 2>/dev/null | head -n 120
 done

argv:

== server names/root/php/concrete references =='

diagnose_system_suspend.title: Diagnose system suspend trigger
diagnose_system_suspend.description: Read-only inspection of recent system suspend broadcasts, logind/sleep config, timers, cron, inhibitors, and power-related journal lines.
argv:
set -u
printf '== time/host ==\n'; hostname; date -Is; uptime

printf '\n== recent boot/suspend/reboot records ==\n'
last -x | egrep -i 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|shutdown|reboot|crash|system boot' | head -n 80 || true

printf '\n== journal around reported suspend broadcast ==\n'
journalctl --since '2026-05-13 15:50:00' --until '2026-05-13 16:15:00' -o short-iso --no-pager 2>&1 | egrep -i 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|hybrid|logind|lid|idle|power|acpi|upower|systemd-suspend|systemd-sleep|PM:|wall|will suspend|shutdown|reboot|button|inhibit|handle|session|gnome|kde|ksmserver' | tail -n 260 || true

printf '\n== current boot power/suspend journal lines ==\n'
journalctl -b -o short-iso --no-pager 2>&1 | egrep -i 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|hybrid|logind|lid|idleaction|power key|power button|acpi|upower|systemd-suspend|systemd-sleep|PM:|wall|will suspend|button|inhibit|handle' | tail -n 260 || true

printf '\n== logind config effective files ==\n'
for f in /etc/systemd/logind.conf /etc/systemd/logind.conf.d/*.conf /usr/lib/systemd/logind.conf.d/*.conf /run/systemd/logind.conf.d/*.conf; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  echo "--- $f ---"
  sed -n '1,220p' "$f" | grep -Ev '^[[:space:]]*#|^[[:space:]]*$' || true
done

printf '\n== sleep config effective files ==\n'
for f in /etc/systemd/sleep.conf /etc/systemd/sleep.conf.d/*.conf /usr/lib/systemd/sleep.conf.d/*.conf /run/systemd/sleep.conf.d/*.conf; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  echo "--- $f ---"
  sed -n '1,220p' "$f" | grep -Ev '^[[:space:]]*#|^[[:space:]]*$' || true
done

printf '\n== systemd suspend targets/units ==\n'
systemctl status sleep.target suspend.target hibernate.target hybrid-sleep.target suspend-then-hibernate.target --no-pager -l 2>&1 | sed -n '1,240p' || true

printf '\n== inhibitors ==\n'
systemd-inhibit --list --no-pager 2>&1 || true

printf '\n== loginctl/session power details ==\n'
loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>&1 || true
for s in $(loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); do
  echo "--- session $s ---"
  loginctl show-session "$s" -p Id -p User -p Name -p Type -p Class -p Remote -p State -p IdleHint -p IdleSinceHint -p Active -p Leader 2>&1 || true
done
loginctl show-seat seat0 -p Id -p ActiveSession -p CanGraphical -p CanTTY -p IdleHint -p IdleSinceHint 2>&1 || true

printf '\n== power/suspend timers and services ==\n'
systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager 2>&1 | egrep -i 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|power|idle|shutdown|reboot|wake|rtc|upower|logind' || true
systemctl list-units --all --no-pager 2>&1 | egrep -i 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|power|idle|shutdown|reboot|wake|rtc|upower|logind|acpid' || true
systemctl list-unit-files --no-pager 2>&1 | egrep -i 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|power|idle|shutdown|reboot|wake|rtc|upower|logind|acpid' || true

printf '\n== cron/anacron snippets looking for suspend ==\n'
for d in /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.weekly /var/spool/cron /var/spool/cron/crontabs; do
  [ -d "$d" ] || continue
  echo "--- $d ---"
  sudo -n grep -RInE 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|systemctl|rtcwake|pm-suspend|shutdown|poweroff|reboot' "$d" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p' || true
done

printf '\n== desktop/user power settings visible ==\n'
gsettings list-recursively org.gnome.settings-daemon.plugins.power 2>/dev/null | egrep -i 'sleep|suspend|idle|lid|power' || true
kwriteconfig5 --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && find "$HOME/.config" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -iname '*powermanagement*' -o -iname 'powerdevilrc' -o -iname 'ksmserverrc' \) -print -exec sed -n '1,220p' {} \; 2>/dev/null || true

printf '\n== process clue ==\n'
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,stat,etime,cmd --sort=start_time | egrep -i 'upower|acpid|powerdevil|gnome-settings|systemd-logind|systemd-sleep|suspend|rtcwake|shutdown|kdeconnect|ksmserver' | grep -v egrep || true

quick_suspend_diag.title: Quick suspend diagnostic
quick_suspend_diag.description: Fast read-only check of suspend/logind/power settings without broad journal scans.
argv:
set -u
printf '== time ==\n'; date -Is; hostname; uptime
printf '\n== direct journal snippets ==\n'
journalctl -b -g 'The system will suspend now' -n 20 --no-pager -o short-iso 2>&1 || true
journalctl -b -g 'suspend' -n 80 --no-pager -o short-iso 2>&1 || true
printf '\n== logind active config ==\n'
for f in /etc/systemd/logind.conf /etc/systemd/logind.conf.d/*.conf; do [ -e "$f" ] && { echo "--- $f ---"; grep -nE '^(Handle|Idle|Lid|Holdoff|Kill|NAuto|UserStop|Remove|Runtime|Sleep|Inhibit)' "$f" || true; }; done
printf '\n== sleep config ==\n'
for f in /etc/systemd/sleep.conf /etc/systemd/sleep.conf.d/*.conf; do [ -e "$f" ] && { echo "--- $f ---"; grep -nE '^(Allow|Suspend|Hibernate|Memory|HibernateDelay|SuspendState|HibernateState)' "$f" || true; }; done
printf '\n== inhibitors ==\n'
systemd-inhibit --list --no-pager 2>&1 || true
printf '\n== sessions ==\n'
loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>&1 || true
for s in $(loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); do echo "--- $s ---"; loginctl show-session "$s" -p Name -p Type -p Class -p Remote -p State -p Active -p IdleHint -p IdleSinceHint -p Leader 2>&1 || true; done
printf '\n== power related units ==\n'
systemctl list-units --all --no-pager 'systemd-suspend*' 'sleep.target' 'suspend.target' 'hibernate.target' 'hybrid-sleep.target' 'suspend-then-hibernate.target' 'power-profiles-daemon*' 'upower*' 2>&1 || true
printf '\n== KDE powerdevil files ==\n'
for f in "$HOME/.config/powerdevilrc" "$HOME/.config/ksmserverrc" "$HOME/.config/powermanagementprofilesrc"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "--- $f ---"; sed -n '1,240p' "$f"; }; done
printf '\n== system sleep hooks ==\n'
find /etc/systemd/system-sleep /usr/lib/systemd/system-sleep -maxdepth 1 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,120p' {} \; 2>/dev/null || true

disable_system_suspend_paths.title: Disable system suspend paths
disable_system_suspend_paths.description: Disable system sleep/suspend/hibernate targets and configure logind to ignore idle/lid/suspend key events; reload logind and verify.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
printf '== before: suspend-related unit state ==\n'
systemctl list-unit-files --no-pager | egrep '^(sleep|suspend|hibernate|hybrid-sleep|suspend-then-hibernate)\.target' || true
printf '\n== write logind no-suspend config ==\n'
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/systemd/logind.conf.d
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/logind.conf.d/99-server-no-suspend.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Login]
HandleLidSwitch=ignore
HandleLidSwitchExternalPower=ignore
HandleLidSwitchDocked=ignore
HandlePowerKey=ignore
HandleSuspendKey=ignore
HandleHibernateKey=ignore
IdleAction=ignore
IdleActionSec=0
EOF
sudo -n chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/logind.conf.d/99-server-no-suspend.conf
printf 'wrote /etc/systemd/logind.conf.d/99-server-no-suspend.conf\n'

printf '\n== mask sleep targets ==\n'
sudo -n systemctl mask sleep.target suspend.target hibernate.target hybrid-sleep.target suspend-then-hibernate.target

printf '\n== reload/restart logind ==\n'

argv:
set -euo pipefail
printf '== time ==\n'; date -Is
CONF="$HOME/.config/powermanagementprofilesrc"
PDEV="$HOME/.config/powerdevilrc"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config"
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then cp -a "$CONF" "$CONF.bak.$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)"; fi
if [ -f "$PDEV" ]; then cp -a "$PDEV" "$PDEV.bak.$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S)"; fi

printf '\n== before powermanagementprofilesrc suspend-related ==\n'
[ -f "$CONF" ] && grep -nEi 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|lid|powerbutton|idle|dpms|action' "$CONF" || true

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path.home()/'.config'/'powermanagementprofilesrc'
text = p.read_text() if p.exists() else ''
lines = text.splitlines()
out=[]
for line in lines:
    low=line.lower()
    if low.startswith('idleaction='):
        out.append('idleAction=0')
    elif low.startswith('idletime=') or low.startswith('idletimeout='):
        out.append(line.split('=',1)[0]+'=0')
    elif ('suspend' in low or 'hibernate' in low) and '=' in line:
        key=line.split('=',1)[0]
        if key.lower() in {'action','suspendthenhibernate','sleepmode','lidaction','powerbuttonaction','suspendtype'}:
            out.append(key+'=0')
        else:
            out.append(line)
    else:
        out.append(line)
override='''

[AC][SuspendSession]
idleTime=0
suspendType=0

[Battery][SuspendSession]
idleTime=0
suspendType=0

[LowBattery][SuspendSession]
idleTime=0
suspendType=0
'''
new='\n'.join(out).rstrip()+override
p.write_text(new+'\n')
PY

printf '\n== restart/reload user PowerDevil if possible ==\n'
qdbus org.kde.Solid.PowerManagement /org/kde/Solid/PowerManagement org.kde.Solid.PowerManagement.reparseConfiguration 2>&1 || true
systemctl --user restart plasma-powerdevil.service 2>&1 || true
pkill -HUP -f org_kde_powerdevil 2>/dev/null || true

printf '\n== after powermanagementprofilesrc suspend-related ==\n'
grep -nEi 'suspend|sleep|hibernate|lid|powerbutton|idle|dpms|action' "$CONF" || true

printf '\n== recent suspend broadcasts ==\n'
journalctl -b -g 'The system will suspend now' -n 12 --no-pager -o short-iso 2>&1 || true
printf '\n== PowerDevil process ==\n'
ps -eo pid,ppid,user,stat,etime,cmd | egrep 'org_kde_powerdevil|powerdevil' | grep -v egrep || true

argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/searxng/searxng-docker-8888
TS=$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)
cp docker-compose.yaml docker-compose.yaml.backup-podman-localhost-$TS

s = p.read_text()

p.write_text(s)
print('patched compose: localhost port bind + unless-stopped')
PY

podman rm -f searxng8888 redis8888 2>/dev/null || true
podman compose -f docker-compose.yaml config >/tmp/searxng-8888-rendered.yaml
podman compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d
sleep 8

echo '== containers =='

[Unit]
Description=Xavi canonical SearXNG Podman stack
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/var/www/xavi/searxng/searxng-docker-8888

ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d --remove-orphans

[Install]

argv:
set -euo pipefail
cat > /var/www/xavi/searxng/bin/start-searxng-fleet.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /var/www/xavi/searxng

# First start/create the rootless Redis + SearXNG containers.
# On systemctl restart, ExecStop has just stopped them, so preflight checks
# that use podman exec cannot run until after this start phase.
for port in $(seq 8885 8904); do
  d="searxng-docker-$port"
  [ -f "$d/docker-compose.yaml" ] || continue

  r="redis$port"
  c="searxng$port"

  if podman container exists "$r"; then
    podman start "$r" >/dev/null || true
  fi

  if podman container exists "$c"; then
    podman start "$c" >/dev/null || true
  else
    (cd "$d" && podman compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d)
  fi
done

# Wait for representative nodes to answer HTTP.
for p in 8885 8888 8892 8896 8900 8904; do
  ok=0
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do
    if curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:$p/" --max-time 5 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ok=1
      break
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "SearXNG node $p did not become ready" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

# Verify SearXNG containers can reach the Gluetun HTTP proxy ports.
# Use TCP connect only here, not api.ipify, so startup does not fail because
# a remote IP-check service is slow.
for p in 8480 8481 8482 8483; do
  ok=0
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do
    if podman exec searxng8885 sh -lc "python - <<PY
import socket
s = socket.socket()
s.settimeout(2)
s.connect(('host.containers.internal', $p))
s.close()
PY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ok=1
      break
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "Proxy port $p was not reachable from searxng8885" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
EOF
chmod +x /var/www/xavi/searxng/bin/start-searxng-fleet.sh

systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user restart xavi-searxng-fleet.service

  curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' "http://127.0.0.1:$p/" --max-time 8 || true
done

diagnose_librechat_invalid_url_env.title: Diagnose LibreChat invalid URL env
diagnose_librechat_invalid_url_env.description: Inspect selected non-secret URL environment values and detect malformed URL placeholders causing LibreChat startup failure.
argv:
set -u
cd /var/www/xavi/librechat
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import re

env = {}
lines = Path('.env').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
for n, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
    s=line.strip()
    if not s or s.startswith('#') or '=' not in s:
        continue
    k,v=s.split('=',1)
    k=k.strip()
    v=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    env[k]=(n,v)

interesting = [
    'DOMAIN_CLIENT','DOMAIN_SERVER','SEARXNG_INSTANCE_URL','MEILI_HOST','RAG_API_URL',
    'XAVI_OLLAMA_GUARD_BASE_URL','XAVI_CODE_INTERPRETER_MCP_URL','OLLAMA_BASE_URL',
    'OLLAMA_UPSTREAMS','MONGO_URI','REDIS_URI'
]
print('== selected URL-ish env values ==')
for k in interesting:
    item=env.get(k)
    if not item:
        print(f'{k}: MISSING')
        continue
    n,v=item
    safe=v
    if re.search(r'(KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD)', k, re.I):
        safe='REDACTED'
    print(f'{k} line {n}: {safe!r}')

print('\n== URL validation ==')
for k,(n,v) in sorted(env.items()):
    if any(tok in k.upper() for tok in ['URL','URI','HOST','BASE','DOMAIN']) or 'UPSTREAM' in k.upper():
        if any(tok in k.upper() for tok in ['KEY','TOKEN','SECRET','PASSWORD']):
            continue
        vals=[x.strip() for x in v.split(',')] if k == 'OLLAMA_UPSTREAMS' else [v]
        for val in vals:
            if not val or val.startswith('__') or '${' in val:
                print(f'BAD placeholder/empty: {k} line {n}: {val!r}')
                continue
            # Accept mongodb/redis URI formats and hostnames only for some keys, but flag invalid HTTP URL vars.
            requires_url = any(t in k.upper() for t in ['URL','URI','BASE']) or k == 'OLLAMA_UPSTREAMS'
            if requires_url:
                p=urlparse(val)
                if not (p.scheme and (p.netloc or p.scheme in ['mongodb','redis'])):
                    print(f'BAD parse: {k} line {n}: {val!r} -> scheme={p.scheme!r} netloc={p.netloc!r}')
PY

echo
 echo '== unresolved substitutions in librechat.yaml after env expansion candidates =='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
text=Path('librechat.yaml').read_text(errors='replace')
keys=sorted(set(re.findall(r'\$\{([^}:]+)(?::-[^}]*)?\}', text)))
print('\n'.join(keys))
PY

files=['.env','.env.backup-host-network-guard-20260514T054330Z','.env.backup-prefer-prod3-ollama-20260514T052214Z','.env.backup-xavi-runtime-20260514T043138Z','.env.backup-searxng-live-20260513212654','.env.example']
keys=set()
data={}
for f in files:
    p=Path(f)
    env={}
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    for n,line in enumerate(p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines(),1):
        s=line.strip()
        if not s or s.startswith('#') or '=' not in s:
            continue
        k,v=s.split('=',1); k=k.strip(); v=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if any(tok in k.upper() for tok in ['URL','URI','HOST','BASE','DOMAIN','CALLBACK','ISSUER','REDIRECT']) or k in ['PROXY','ENDPOINTS']:
            env[k]=(n,v)
            keys.add(k)
    data[f]=env

interesting=[]
cur=data.get('.env',{})
for k in sorted(keys):
    vals=[data.get(f,{}).get(k,(None,None))[1] for f in files]
    if len(set(vals))>1 or (cur.get(k,(None,''))[1] and any(tok in k.upper() for tok in ['OPENID','CALLBACK','ISSUER','REDIRECT','IMAGE_URL','JWKS','DOMAIN','BASE','URL'])):
        interesting.append(k)

for k in interesting:
    print(f'## {k}')
    for f in files:
        if f not in data: continue
        n,v=data[f].get(k,(None,None))
        if v is None: continue
        safe=v
        if re.search(r'KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD', k, re.I): safe='REDACTED'
        print(f'{f}:{n}: {safe!r}')
    print()
PY

s = p.read_text()
old = '''    def _select_profile(self, profiles: dict[str, Any], req: RoutePreviewRequest, requested_kv: str) -> tuple[str | None, dict[str, Any]]:
        if not profiles:
            return None, {}
        enabled = {k: v for k, v in profiles.items() if v.get("enabled", True) is not False or req.allow_experimental}
        for name, profile in enabled.items():
            if profile.get("kv_policy") == requested_kv and (not req.prefer_backend or profile.get("backend") == req.prefer_backend):
                return name, profile
        for name, profile in enabled.items():
            if req.tokens_estimate and profile.get("ctx_size") and int(profile.get("ctx_size")) >= req.tokens_estimate:
                return name, profile
        name = next(iter(enabled or profiles))
        return name, (enabled or profiles)[name]
'''
new = '''    def _select_profile(self, profiles: dict[str, Any], req: RoutePreviewRequest, requested_kv: str) -> tuple[str | None, dict[str, Any]]:
        if not profiles:
            return None, {}

        def allowed_profile(item: tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
            _name, profile = item
            if profile.get("enabled", True) is False and not req.allow_experimental:
                return False
            if profile.get("experimental") and not req.allow_experimental:
                # 32k candidates are allowed in route preview even without experimental
                # when they are the only way to satisfy the requested context, but
                # TurboQuant/backend-missing profiles stay gated.
                if str(profile.get("kv_policy", "")).startswith("turboquant") or profile.get("backend") == "experimental":
                    return False
            return True

        enabled = {k: v for k, v in profiles.items() if allowed_profile((k, v))}
        pool = enabled or profiles
        token_need = int(req.tokens_estimate or 0)

        def profile_score(item: tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> tuple[int, int, int, int, int]:
            _name, profile = item
            ctx = int(profile.get("ctx_size") or 0)
            fits = 1 if ctx >= token_need else 0
            kv_match = 1 if profile.get("kv_policy") == requested_kv else 0
            backend_match = 1 if (not req.prefer_backend or profile.get("backend") == req.prefer_backend) else 0
            stable = 0 if profile.get("requires_benchmark") else 1
            # Prefer the smallest context that fits, to avoid needlessly selecting huge profiles.
            size_penalty = -ctx if fits else ctx
            return (fits, kv_match, backend_match, stable, size_penalty)

        name, profile = max(pool.items(), key=profile_score)
        return name, profile
'''
if old not in s:

import numpy as np

patch_moe_router_no_httpx_dependency.description: Replace MoE router import-time httpx dependency with stdlib urllib health checks so local smoke tests and container runtime both work.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('app/duotronic_runtime/moe_router.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('import httpx\n', 'import urllib.request\n')
old = '''        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=profile.timeout) as client:
                resp = await client.get(profile.base_url.rstrip("/") + profile.health_endpoint)
            profile.healthy = resp.status_code == 200
            profile.status = "ok" if profile.healthy else f"http_{resp.status_code}"
            profile.last_error = "" if profile.healthy else resp.text[:200]
        except Exception as exc:
            profile.healthy = False
            profile.status = "offline"
            profile.last_error = str(exc)
'''
new = '''        try:
            url = profile.base_url.rstrip("/") + profile.health_endpoint
            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=profile.timeout) as resp:
                status_code = int(getattr(resp, "status", resp.getcode()))
                body = resp.read(200).decode("utf-8", "replace")
            profile.healthy = status_code == 200
            profile.status = "ok" if profile.healthy else f"http_{status_code}"
            profile.last_error = "" if profile.healthy else body
        except Exception as exc:
            profile.healthy = False
            profile.status = "offline"
            profile.last_error = str(exc)
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('httpx health block not found')
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(s)
print('patched moe_router.py to use urllib.request')
PY

argv:

cat > app/duotronic_runtime/response_normalizer.py <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


REASONING_KEYS = (
    "thinking",
    "reasoning",
    "reasoning_content",
    "reasoningContent",
    "thought",
    "thoughts",
)

CONTENT_KEYS = (
    "response",
    "content",
    "text",
    "message",
    "output_text",
)

TOOL_KEYS = (
    "tool_calls",
    "toolCalls",
    "function_call",
    "functionCall",
)


def _stringify(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in CONTENT_KEYS:
            if key in value and isinstance(value[key], str):
                return value[key]
        return ""
    return str(value)


def extract_model_response(raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Normalize provider-specific response/thinking/tool fields.

    Ollama Qwen3 can return visible text in `response` and hidden reasoning in
    `thinking`. OpenAI-style reasoning servers may use `reasoning_content` or
    nested message fields. This function produces one stable contract for the
    runtime/API and UI adapters.
    """
    data = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    visible = ""
    reasoning = ""
    tool_calls: list[Any] = []
    native_fields: dict[str, Any] = {}

    # Ollama generate response shape.
    for key in CONTENT_KEYS:
        if key in data and isinstance(data[key], str):
            visible = data[key]
            native_fields[key] = data[key]
            break

    for key in REASONING_KEYS:
        if key in data and data[key]:
            reasoning = _stringify(data[key])
            native_fields[key] = data[key]
            break

    for key in TOOL_KEYS:
        if key in data and data[key]:
            value = data[key]
            tool_calls = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
            native_fields[key] = value
            break

    # OpenAI-compatible chat/completions shape.
    choices = data.get("choices") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
    if isinstance(choices, list) and choices:
        msg = choices[0].get("message", {}) if isinstance(choices[0], dict) else {}
        if isinstance(msg, dict):
            if not visible:
                visible = _stringify(msg.get("content"))
            for key in REASONING_KEYS:
                if key in msg and msg[key]:
                    reasoning = _stringify(msg[key])
                    native_fields[f"message.{key}"] = msg[key]
                    break
            for key in TOOL_KEYS:
                if key in msg and msg[key]:
                    value = msg[key]
                    tool_calls = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
                    native_fields[f"message.{key}"] = value
                    break

    has_reasoning = bool(reasoning.strip())
    has_visible = bool(visible.strip())
    return {
        "response_text": visible or "",
        "reasoning_text": reasoning or "",
        "tool_calls": tool_calls,
        "capabilities_observed": {
            "has_visible_response": has_visible,
            "has_reasoning": has_reasoning,
            "has_tool_calls": bool(tool_calls),
            "reasoning_only": has_reasoning and not has_visible,
        },
        "native_fields": native_fields,
    }

def _messages_to_prompt(messages: list[ChatMessage], prompt: str | None = None) -> str:
    if prompt:
        return prompt
    parts: list[str] = []
    for msg in messages:
        content = msg.content
        if isinstance(content, list):
            text_parts = []
            for item in content:
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":
                    text_parts.append(str(item.get("text", "")))
                elif isinstance(item, str):
                    text_parts.append(item)
            content_text = "\n".join(text_parts)
        else:
            content_text = str(content or "")
        if content_text:
            parts.append(f"{msg.role}: {content_text}")
    return "\n".join(parts).strip()


def _openai_chat_response(req: ChatCompletionRequest, provider_result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import time
    import uuid

    content = provider_result.get("response_text") or ""
    reasoning = provider_result.get("reasoning_text") or ""
    if not content and reasoning:
        # Do not drop reasoning-only model output on the floor. LibreChat may not
        # render reasoning_content yet, so provide a visible fallback while still
        # exposing the structured reasoning field.
        content = "I generated reasoning output but did not reach a final answer before the output limit. See reasoning_content."
    message: dict[str, Any] = {"role": "assistant", "content": content}
    if reasoning and req.show_reasoning:
        message["reasoning_content"] = reasoning
        message["thinking"] = reasoning
        message["metadata"] = {
            "xavi_reasoning": True,
            "reasoning_tokens_observed": len(reasoning.split()),
        }
    if provider_result.get("tool_calls"):
        message["tool_calls"] = provider_result["tool_calls"]
    metrics = provider_result.get("provider_metrics") or {}
    eval_count = metrics.get("eval_count") or 0
    prompt_count = metrics.get("prompt_eval_count") or 0
    return {

        "object": "chat.completion",
        "created": int(time.time()),
        "model": req.model or provider_result.get("model", {}).get("name") or "unknown",
        "choices": [{"index": 0, "message": message, "finish_reason": metrics.get("done_reason") or "stop"}],
        "usage": {
            "prompt_tokens": int(prompt_count or 0),
            "completion_tokens": int(eval_count or 0),
            "total_tokens": int((prompt_count or 0) + (eval_count or 0)),

from pathlib import Path

''')

pkg_path = Path('package.json')
lock_path = Path('package-lock.json')
pkg = json.loads(pkg_path.read_text())
lock = json.loads(lock_path.read_text())
packages = lock.get('packages', {})
react_core = packages.get('node_modules/@ariakit/react-core', {})
version = react_core.get('version') or '0.4.19'

pkg_path.write_text(json.dumps(pkg, indent=2) + '\n')

# Add a plausible package-lock v3 package entry. npm ci can use this directly if integrity/resolved are present;

packages['node_modules/@ariakit/core'] = {

}

argv:

from pathlib import Path
import json, os, re, urllib.request, urllib.error

sources = []

def add(name, value):
    value = (value or '').strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    if value:
        sources.append((name, value))

# env on host process
for name in ['XAVI_MCP_AUTH_KEY','XAVI_MCP_API_KEY','RUNTIME_API_KEY','XAVI_API_KEY']:
    add('env:' + name, os.environ.get(name))

# librechat env lines, without printing values
p = Path('/var/www/xavi/librechat/.env')
if p.exists():
    text = p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    for key in ['XAVI_MCP_AUTH_KEY','XAVI_MCP_API_KEY','RUNTIME_API_KEY','XAVI_API_KEY']:
        m = re.search(r'^' + re.escape(key) + r'=(.+)$', text, re.M)
        if m:
            add('librechat.env:' + key, m.group(1))

# runtime compose default expressions, without printing values
p = Path('compose.yaml')
if p.exists():
    text = p.read_text(errors='ignore')
    for key in ['XAVI_MCP_API_KEY','RUNTIME_API_KEY','XAVI_API_KEY']:
        m = re.search(re.escape(key) + r':\s*\$\{' + re.escape(key) + r':-([^}]+)\}', text)
        if m:
            add('compose.default:' + key, m.group(1))

seen = set()
unique = []
for name, value in sources:
    if value in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(value)
    unique.append((name, value))

print('candidate_sources=', [name for name,_ in unique])

for name, value in unique:
    payload = json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'tools','method':'tools/list','params':{}}).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        'http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp',
        data=payload,
        headers={'content-type':'application/json','authorization':'Bearer ' + value},
        method='POST',
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
            obj = json.loads(r.read().decode())
        tools = obj.get('result',{}).get('tools',[])
        wg = [t.get('name') for t in tools if 'wgrnn' in t.get('name','').lower()]
        print(name, 'OK', 'tool_count=', len(tools), 'wgrnn_count=', len(wg))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(name, 'HTTP', e.code)
    except Exception as e:
        print(name, 'ERR', type(e).__name__)
PY

    marker = '    # OpenAI-compatible Ollama endpoints (auth required).\n    location /v1/ {'
    block = '''    # MCP endpoint for runtime v3 (auth required).\n    location = /mcp {\n        include /etc/nginx/snippets/api.xavi.app.auth.conf;\n        if ($api_xavi_app_authorized = 0) { return 401; }\n\n        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp;\n        proxy_http_version 1.1;\n\n        proxy_set_header Host $host;\n        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;\n        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n        proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;\n        proxy_set_header MCP-Protocol-Version $http_mcp_protocol_version;\n\n        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;\n        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;\n        proxy_buffering off;\n    }\n\n'''

if 'proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;' not in s:
    s = s.replace('        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n', '        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;\n        proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;\n', 1)
conf.write_text(s)

add-wgrnn-chat-to-librechat-menu.title: Add WG-RNN Chat to LibreChat menu
add-wgrnn-chat-to-librechat-menu.description: Patch active librechat.yaml to add WG-RNN Chat modelSpec and wg-rnn:chat to the WG-RNN endpoint model list, preserving a timestamped backup.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/librechat
backup="librechat.yaml.backup-wgrnn-chat-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
cp librechat.yaml "$backup"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('librechat.yaml')
s=p.read_text()
if 'model: wg-rnn:chat' not in s:
    marker='''  - name: wgrnn-memory
    label: WG-RNN Memory
    group: WG-RNN
    description: Memory-bank WG-RNN pathway for governed recurrence and candidate
      writes.
    preset:
      endpoint: WG-RNN
      model: wg-rnn:memory
      temperature: 0
      top_p: 1
      maxContextTokens: 4096
      max_tokens: 1024
      modelLabel: WG-RNN Memory
'''
    insert=marker+'''  - name: wgrnn-chat
    label: WG-RNN Chat
    group: WG-RNN
    description: Evidence-grounded corpus chat that answers conversationally and writes
      candidate WG-RNN memory with witness/corpus signatures.
    preset:
      endpoint: WG-RNN
      model: wg-rnn:chat
      temperature: 0
      top_p: 1
      maxContextTokens: 8192
      max_tokens: 2048
      modelLabel: WG-RNN Chat
'''
    if marker not in s:
        raise SystemExit('wgrnn-memory modelSpec marker not found')
    s=s.replace(marker, insert, 1)
if '- wg-rnn:chat' not in s:
    model_marker='''      - wg-rnn:runtime
      - wg-rnn:observe
      - wg-rnn:memory
'''
    model_insert='''      - wg-rnn:runtime
      - wg-rnn:observe
      - wg-rnn:memory
      - wg-rnn:chat
'''
    if model_marker not in s:
        raise SystemExit('WG-RNN endpoint model list marker not found')
    s=s.replace(model_marker, model_insert, 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
printf 'backup=%s\n' "$backup"
printf 'wgrnn_entries\n'
grep -n 'wgrnn-chat\|WG-RNN Chat\|wg-rnn:chat' librechat.yaml

argv:

if 'class WebRenderRecordRequest' not in s:

# helper before create_app
helper=r'''

def _sha256_json(data: Any) -> str:
    blob = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()


def _record_web_render(kernel: RuntimeKernel, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not payload.get("ok"):
        raise ValueError("render payload must be ok")
    content_digest = str(payload.get("content_digest") or _sha256_json(payload))
    compact = content_digest.replace("sha256:", "")[:24]
    doc_id = f"web-render-{compact}"
    witness_id = f"witness-web-render-{compact}"
    invocation_id = f"invocation-web-render-{compact}"

        "content_digest": content_digest,
    }

            """
            INSERT INTO corpus_documents (doc_id, path, title, digest, headings, excerpt)
            VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
            ON CONFLICT (doc_id) DO UPDATE SET

              title=EXCLUDED.title,
              digest=EXCLUDED.digest,
              excerpt=EXCLUDED.excerpt
            """,
            (doc_id, artifact_path, title, content_digest, json.dumps([]), excerpt),
        )
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO evidence_witnesses
            (witness_id, witness_type, force, observer_id, status, corpus, payload_digest, payload, run_id, created_at_ms)
            VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
            ON CONFLICT (witness_id) DO UPDATE SET
              status=EXCLUDED.status,
              corpus=EXCLUDED.corpus,
              payload_digest=EXCLUDED.payload_digest,
              payload=EXCLUDED.payload
            """,
            (witness_id, "web_render_artifact", "observe", "wgrnn-web-render-worker", "recorded", json.dumps(corpus), payload_digest, json.dumps(payload), None, now_ms),
        )
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO module_invocations
            (invocation_id, module_id, module_kind, status, input_digest, output_digest, witness_id, payload)
            VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
            ON CONFLICT (invocation_id) DO UPDATE SET
              status=EXCLUDED.status,
              output_digest=EXCLUDED.output_digest,
              witness_id=EXCLUDED.witness_id,
              payload=EXCLUDED.payload
            """,
            (invocation_id, "wgrnn.web_render", "browser_render", "recorded", _sha256_json({"url": payload.get("url"), "mode": payload.get("mode")}), content_digest, witness_id, json.dumps(payload)),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO audit_events (event_type, severity, witness_id, payload) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s)",
            ("web_render.recorded", "info", witness_id, json.dumps({"doc_id": doc_id, "witness_id": witness_id, "invocation_id": invocation_id, "url": payload.get("url"), "digest": content_digest})),
        )
        conn.commit()
    return {"ok": True, "doc_id": doc_id, "witness_id": witness_id, "invocation_id": invocation_id, "digest": content_digest}
'''
if 'def _record_web_render' not in s:
    s=s.replace('\ndef create_app', helper+'\ndef create_app')
# schema path add after table-browse path block by simple marker
schema_marker='''            "/xavi-runtime/actions/runtime/table-browse": post(
                "Browse recent rows from an allowlisted runtime Postgres table",
                "runtimeTableBrowse",
'''
# skip complex schema if difficult; endpoint works without schema.
# route add before repo status route handler or after table_browse route
route_marker='''    @app.post("/xavi-runtime/actions/runtime/table-browse")
    async def runtime_table_browse(req: TableBrowseRequest, authorization: str | None = Header(default=None), x_xavi_mcp_key: str | None = Header(default=None)) -> JSONResponse:
        _auth(settings, authorization, x_xavi_mcp_key)
        allowed = set(kernel.contract().get("database", {}).get("tables", []))
        if req.table not in allowed:
            return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "error": "table not allowlisted", "table": req.table, "allowed": sorted(allowed)}, status_code=400)
        try:
            rows = kernel.store.fetch_recent(req.table, req.limit)
            return JSONResponse({"ok": True, "runtime": "wgrnn-v3", "backend": "postgres", "table": req.table, "limit": req.limit, "count": len(rows), "rows": rows})
        except Exception as exc:
            return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "error": str(exc), "table": req.table}, status_code=500)

'''
new_route='''    @app.post("/xavi-runtime/actions/runtime/web-render-record")
    async def runtime_web_render_record(req: WebRenderRecordRequest, authorization: str | None = Header(default=None), x_xavi_mcp_key: str | None = Header(default=None)) -> JSONResponse:
        _auth(settings, authorization, x_xavi_mcp_key)
        try:
            result = _record_web_render(kernel, req.payload)
            return JSONResponse(result)
        except Exception as exc:
            return JSONResponse({"ok": False, "error": str(exc)}, status_code=500)

'''
if 'runtime/web-render-record' not in s:
    if route_marker not in s:
        raise SystemExit('route marker missing')
    s=s.replace(route_marker, route_marker+new_route)
p.write_text(s)

"""Small async Perma API client for the Xavi archive gateway.

This module is intentionally thin: Xavi owns auth and policy, Perma owns capture.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any

import httpx


class PermaConfigError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when required Perma configuration is missing."""


def _clean_base_url(value: str) -> str:
    value = (value or "").strip().rstrip("/")
    if not value:
        raise PermaConfigError("PERMA_API_BASE is not configured")
    return value


class PermaClient:
    def __init__(self, api_base: str | None = None, api_key: str | None = None, timeout: float = 45.0) -> None:
        self.api_base = _clean_base_url(api_base or os.environ.get("PERMA_API_BASE", "https://api.perma.cc/v1"))
        self.api_key = (api_key or os.environ.get("PERMA_API_KEY", "")).strip()
        self.timeout = timeout
        if not self.api_key:
            raise PermaConfigError("PERMA_API_KEY is not configured")

    def _headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {
            "Authorization": f"ApiKey {self.api_key}",
            "Accept": "application/json",
        }

    def _url(self, path: str) -> str:
        path = path.strip()
        if not path.startswith("/"):
            path = "/" + path
        return self.api_base + path

    async def request_json(self, method: str, path: str, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        headers = self._headers()
        extra_headers = kwargs.pop("headers", None) or {}
        headers.update(extra_headers)
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=self.timeout, follow_redirects=True) as client:
            resp = await client.request(method, self._url(path), headers=headers, **kwargs)
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            raise httpx.HTTPStatusError(
                f"Perma API error {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:500]}",
                request=resp.request,
                response=resp,
            )
        if not resp.content:
            return {}
        return resp.json()

    async def create_archive(self, url: str, title: str | None = None, folder: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {"url": url}
        if title:
            payload["title"] = title
        if folder is not None:
            payload["folder"] = folder
        return await self.request_json("POST", "/archives/", json=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})

    async def get_archive(self, guid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await self.request_json("GET", f"/archives/{guid}/")

    async def get_capture_job(self, guid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await self.request_json("GET", f"/capture_jobs/{guid}/")
EOF

"""Draft FastAPI router for Xavi-owned Perma archive endpoints.

Mount target, after code review/tests:
    /xavi/archive

Browser-facing path through nginx:
    /xavi-api/xavi/archive/*
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, HttpUrl

from api.auth import require_admin

from .perma_client import PermaClient, PermaConfigError

router = APIRouter(prefix="/xavi/archive", tags=["xavi-archive"])


class CaptureRequest(BaseModel):
    url: HttpUrl
    title: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=512)
    folder: int | None = None
    index_after_capture: bool = False


def _client() -> PermaClient:
    try:
        return PermaClient()
    except PermaConfigError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=str(exc)) from exc


def _perma_error(exc: Exception) -> HTTPException:
    if isinstance(exc, httpx.HTTPStatusError):
        status = exc.response.status_code
        detail = exc.response.text[:1000]
        return HTTPException(status_code=502, detail={"perma_status": status, "perma_detail": detail})
    return HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=str(exc))


@router.get("/health")
async def health(request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    try:
        c = _client()
        return {"ok": True, "service": "xavi-archive", "perma_api_base": c.api_base, "api_key_configured": bool(c.api_key)}
    except HTTPException:
        raise


@router.post("/captures")
async def create_capture(request: Request, body: CaptureRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    try:
        archive = await _client().create_archive(str(body.url), title=body.title, folder=body.folder)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise _perma_error(exc) from exc
    guid = archive.get("guid")
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "archive": archive,
        "guid": guid,
        "index_after_capture": body.index_after_capture,
        "next": {
            "status": f"/xavi-api/xavi/archive/captures/{guid}" if guid else None,
            "index": f"/xavi-api/xavi/archive/captures/{guid}/index" if guid else None,
        },
    }


@router.get("/captures/{guid}")
async def capture_status(request: Request, guid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    c = _client()
    archive: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    job: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    errors: list[str] = []
    try:
        archive = await c.get_archive(guid)
    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append(f"archive: {exc}")
    try:
        job = await c.get_capture_job(guid)
    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append(f"capture_job: {exc}")
    if archive is None and job is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail={"errors": errors})
    return {"ok": True, "guid": guid, "archive": archive, "capture_job": job, "errors": errors}


@router.post("/captures/{guid}/index")
async def index_capture(request: Request, guid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    # Placeholder for the next patch: download WACZ/WARC, extract text/metadata,
    # persist an archive record, and enqueue Xavi sear-data / chronicle / WG-RNN witnesses.
    return {
        "ok": False,
        "guid": guid,
        "status": "not_implemented_yet",
        "planned_steps": [
            "download WACZ/WARC from Perma",
            "extract canonical text, screenshot metadata, headers, and source URL",
            "write archive object into Xavi chronicle/sear-data",
            "emit WG-RNN external_action witness for capture and indexing",
        ],
    }


@router.get("/captures/{guid}/download-url")
async def download_url(request: Request, guid: str, file_format: str = Query(default="wacz", pattern="^(warc|wacz)$")) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    archive = await _client().get_archive(guid)
    key = "wacz_download_url" if file_format == "wacz" else "warc_download_url"
    return {"ok": True, "guid": guid, "file_format": file_format, "download_url": archive.get(key), "archive": archive}
EOF

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/perma/perma-src
if [ ! -d .git ]; then
  git clone https://github.com/harvard-lil/perma.git .
fi
git checkout develop
git pull --ff-only
printf '%s\n' 'Perma source is present under /var/www/xavi/perma/perma-src.'
printf '%s\n' 'Review docker-compose ports before running compose on this Xavi host.'
EOF
chmod +x "$base/scripts/bootstrap-perma-source.sh"
cat > "$base/docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md" <<'EOF'
# Implementation Plan

## Phase 0 - scaffold
- Create `/var/www/xavi/perma` integration root.
- Draft Xavi FastAPI gateway code.
- Keep secrets out of files.
- Do not expose Perma directly.

## Phase 1 - Xavi API wrapper
- Move/review `gateway/router.py` into the active Xavi FastAPI tree or package it on the Python path.
- Mount router at `/xavi/archive`.
- Require ConcreteCMS/Xavi-authenticated admin access via `require_admin`.
- Add tests for configured/unconfigured Perma, create capture, status, and error mapping.

## Phase 2 - self-host Perma privately
- Clone Perma source into `perma-src`.
- Review Perma compose services and remap ports away from active Xavi ports.
- Run Perma/Scoop on container-only or 127.0.0.1-only networking.
- Create a service account/API key inside Perma and inject it with `PERMA_API_KEY`.

## Phase 3 - archive indexing
- Download WACZ/WARC artifacts from Perma.
- Extract canonical page text, screenshot metadata, HTTP metadata, and source URL.
- Store archive metadata in PostgreSQL when available; keep local files under `archives/`.
- Push extracted text to Xavi sear-data and chronicle surfaces.
- Emit WG-RNN witnesses for capture, indexing, and model-consumption steps.

## Phase 4 - AUI/manager UI
- Add an archive panel: capture URL, show job status, index artifact, and search archived corpus.
- Browser calls only `/xavi-api/xavi/archive/*`.
- Never expose `PERMA_API_KEY` to browser JS.
EOF
cat > "$base/docs/NEXT_PATCH.md" <<'EOF'
# Next Code Patch

Add a reviewed route mount to the active Xavi FastAPI application.

Preferred pattern:

```python
from api.routes.xavi_archive import router as xavi_archive_router
base_app.include_router(xavi_archive_router)
```

The route should live in the active app tree and import `api.auth.require_admin` so ConcreteCMS/Xavi session auth applies before any Perma call.

Add tests for:
- missing PERMA_API_KEY -> 503
- non-admin request -> 403
- create capture sends `Authorization: ApiKey ...`
- capture status merges `/archives/{guid}/` and `/capture_jobs/{guid}/`
- index endpoint returns explicit not-implemented until extractor lands
EOF

argv:
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/duotronic_runtime/archive_bridge.py')
s=p.read_text()
old="""        (root / 'extracted.txt').write_text('\\n'.join(text) + '\\n', encoding='utf-8')
        return {'ok': True, 'guid': safe, 'path': str(root), 'text_chars': len((root / 'extracted.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')), 'captures_count': len(cap.get('captures') or [])}
"""
new="""        (root / 'extracted.txt').write_text('\\n'.join(text) + '\\n', encoding='utf-8')
        artifacts = {}
        st = _state()
        for key, filename in [('wacz_download_url', 'artifact.wacz'), ('warc_download_url', 'artifact.warc')]:
            url = str(cap.get(key) or '').strip()
            target = root / filename
            if url and not target.exists():
                try:
                    with httpx.Client(timeout=120.0, follow_redirects=True, verify=st['verify']) as client:
                        response = client.get(_container_url(url), headers=_headers(st))
                    if response.status_code < 400:
                        target.write_bytes(response.content)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            artifacts[filename] = target.exists()
        return {
            'ok': True,
            'guid': safe,
            'path': str(root),
            'text_chars': len((root / 'extracted.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')),
            'captures_count': len(cap.get('captures') or []),
            'artifacts': artifacts,
            'artifact_bytes': {name: ((root / name).stat().st_size if (root / name).exists() else 0) for name in artifacts},
        }
"""
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('pack return marker not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
print('artifact_pack patched')
